environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed on Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards enforcement. The namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes built-in admission). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-privilege-escalation' with validationFailureAction: Enforce applies mutating rules that strip any securityContext.privileged, hostPath volumes, and capabilities beyond NET_BIND_SERVICE. The OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate K8sPSPHostFilesystem with parameter 'allowedHostPaths: []' is also active. Container runtime is gVisor (runsc) with default seccomp filtering that blocks execve from writable+executable memory regions. The native library is compiled with -fstack-protector-strong and full RELRO.
